name: Proving Grounds 23: The Broken Stair. A chain of islands adrift in the sky, climbing from a landing in the west to a shrine at the summit: rope bridges are the only ways between them, so every crossing is a chokepoint; the north and south ways split at the landing and meet again at a ruined plaza, and two bridges and a stair lead on to the summit meadow and the shrine above it.
